name: Glass Ball Wall Lamp
desc: A decorative wall sconce featuring a glowing opal glass globe suspended within a teardrop-shaped brass frame. The round wall plate, warm metallic detailing, and softly diffused globe create an elegant ambient accent suited to contemporary living spaces, bedrooms, hallways, and hospitality interiors.

specifications.Light Source: Integrated LED or compact LED bulb

specifications.Recommended Use: Living room / Bedroom / Hallway / Vanity / Lounge / Hospitality
